texto.es: Nos cuentas la raza, el tamaño y el pelaje de tu perro, y te ayudamos a agendar un horario que te sirva.
texto.en: Tell us your dog's breed, size and coat, and we will help you find a time that works.

texto.es: Traes a tu perro al salón en Wilton Dr. Un espacio limpio y tranquilo, pensado para que se sienta cómodo desde que llega.
texto.en: You bring your dog to the salon on Wilton Dr. A clean, calm space, built so they feel comfortable from the moment they arrive.

texto.es: Baño, corte de estilo según su raza y pelaje, y corte de uñas, con el mismo cuidado paciente que ves en nuestras fotos.
texto.en: Bath, breed-appropriate styling and nail trim, with the same patient care you see in our photos.

texto.es: Recoges a tu perro limpio, peinado y tranquilo, listo para que lo presumas en casa.
texto.en: You pick up your dog clean, styled and relaxed, ready to show off at home.

nota.es: Cada servicio se cotiza según la raza, el pelaje y lo que necesite tu perro, luego de un vistazo rápido. Llamanos y te damos el detalle sin compromiso.
nota.en: Every service is quoted based on breed, coat and what your dog needs, after a quick look. Call us and we will walk you through it, no strings attached.

texto.es: Baño, secado, corte de estilo según su raza y acabado final para que tu perro luzca como nuevo.
texto.en: Bath, blow-dry, breed-appropriate styling and a finishing touch so your dog looks brand new.

texto.es: Baño completo, secado y cepillado a fondo para mantener su pelaje limpio y sin nudos entre grooming y grooming.
texto.en: A full bath, blow-dry and thorough brush-out to keep the coat clean and tangle-free between grooms.

texto.es: Corte de uñas con calma y paciencia, incluso para los perros que normalmente se resisten a esta parte.
texto.en: Calm, patient nail trimming, even for dogs that usually fight this part the most.

texto.es: Cortes pensados para el pelaje de cada raza, con pañoletas y acabados que se ven en nuestras fotos.
texto.en: Cuts shaped for each breed's coat, with the bandanas and finishing touches you see in our photos.

pie.es: ¿No ves exactamente lo que necesita tu perro? Llamanos igual: la mayoría de nuestras citas empiezan como una consulta rápida.
pie.en: Do not see exactly what your dog needs? Call us anyway: most of our appointments start out as a quick question.

items.quote: We love Namastegrand Petstylists! Felton is kind, patient, and effective. You can tell he cares about the fur family he is entrusted with. Our dog Bear just loves him, and he leaves so cute and soft. It is very clean and calm inside, smells great, and feels like a spa. We are so happy to have found this gem!

I have been coming here for several years. My Cavachon always gets the best haircut. My dog never "acts weird" after leaving here and she appears to look forward (tail wagging) to going to her favorite "beauty parlor." This establishment is extremely clean and the owner is so kind and treats my dog very well. Highly recommend.

Felton is amazing with my senior dog. He hates getting his nails trimmed and I have always had trouble getting it done and done well. But when Felton does it for him with such ease, my dog feels so comfortable and he does a great job
